correctness.rationale: A reconstruction of the spherical addition theorem fixes the rank/evaluation equivalence and antipodal 12×12 reduction. Exact rational arithmetic verifies every degree 0..128 and the degree-eight nonzero null vector in the attached executable. The Bernstein Legendre bound verified against Gautschi–Giordano (2008), equation (56), bounds all off-diagonal sums by 11 sqrt(10/(3πℓ))<1 for ℓ≥129, proving strict positivity of the reduced Gram in the entire infinite tail. All definitions, parity, normalization and cutoffs are explicit; no finite experiment is claimed as a proof of an infinite range.

value.rationale: The natural 24-vertex Archimedean configuration has a complete, sharp all-degree exact-harmonic interpolation cutoff, not just an isolated table entry. The rank drop from 12 at degree seven to 11 at degree eight is a genuine spectral hole with an explicit degree-six alternating harmonic as its unique annihilator; no further holes occur beyond nine by a uniform analytic proof. This gives exact parity-compatible interpolation thresholds for a symmetric spherical sampling grid. The value does not depend on a conjectural downstream theorem or numerical conditioning claim.
